summary: The proposed patch simplifies the `_check_homomorphism` function and addresses the issue with inverted generators in `PermutationGroup`. However, it lacks comprehensive testing and does not cover all edge cases.

issues.description: The patch lacks comprehensive testing, which may not cover all edge cases and ensure the fix is robust.
The patch appears to be a special-case fix for the failing test rather than a general solution to handle inverted generators in `PermutationGroup`.
